principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling multiple responsibilities, including item management and payment processing.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the payment processing logic into a separate class, such as PaymentProcessor, and pass it to the Order class.

principle_violations.reason: The pay method violates the open/closed principle as it requires modification to add new payment methods.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a payment strategy pattern where each payment type is handled by a different strategy class, allowing for extension without modifying the existing code.
